title: Protein hydrolysate derived from Stichopus horrens with antibacterial activity: preparation, characterization, and antibacterial mechanism
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22282-22292
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03185D, Paper
Open Access

Hongrui Dong, Jinhong Huang, Lefan Li, Pengzhi Hong, Zhang Hu
Sea cucumber protein hydrolysate derived from Stichopus horrens, with a protein peptide content of 82.9%, exhibited potent antibacterial activity, and its mechanism was investigated via molecular docking.
